entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Volcanic island or continent of Dominaria, its most powerful source of red mana.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: Lizard-folk who know how to navigate Shiv's waters.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Descendants of goblin slaves who operated the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Rhammidarigaaz
entities.description: Primeval dragon imprisoned in a volcano, reborn as Gherridarigaaz's son.

entities.name: Gherridarigaaz
entities.description: Dragon who made peace with Urza.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: Primeval dragon whose caldera is a tomb; reincarnated.

entities.name: Mana Rig
entities.description: Thran outpost structure producing powerstones and Thran steel.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Settled on Shiv in his quest against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Ghitu student of Urza who helped form the Shivan Nation.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased out part of Shiv and later restored it at the cost of his spark.

entities.name: Shivan Nation
entities.description: Political body formed in 4520 AR led by a council of eight elders.

entities.name: New Phyrexians
entities.description: Used Cometia Crater as staging ground.

entities.name: Cometia
entities.description: Oasis in a meteor crater, staging ground of the Second Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: Ancient empire that built the Mana Rig.

events.summary: Urza settles on Shiv by making peace with Gherridarigaaz and persuading goblins to work with viashino; the Rig produces powerstones for his Legacy.
events.quote: managed to settle with the viashino living by the Rig by making peace with the dragon Gherridarigaaz

events.summary: Jhoira uses the Rig against the Phyrexians; Teferi phases a chunk of Shiv out with Jhoira and part of the Rig.
events.quote: Teferi phased out a large chunk of Shiv along with Jhoira and part of the Mana Rig

events.summary: Rhammidarigaaz discovers his origin and begins awakening the other dragons.
events.quote: discovered his origin and started awakening the other dragons

events.summary: Teferi returns Shiv to its whole form at the expense of his spark.
events.quote: at the expense of his planeswalker's spark

events.summary: Ghitu and goblins fight over the Rig; Jhoira negotiates a truce and repairs it.
events.quote: Jhoira negotiated a truce and managed to repair the Mana Rig

events.summary: Jhoira and Darigaaz form the Shivan Nation in 4520 AR.
events.quote: she was instrumental in forming the Shivan Nation in 4520 AR

events.summary: The New Phyrexians use Cometia Crater as a staging ground, attack the Mana Rig, then strike Urza's Tower in New Argive.
events.quote: before launching their attack on Shiv's Mana Rig

relations.quote: her old friend, the planeswalker Teferi
who had been reborn as Gherridarigaaz's son
making peace with the dragon Gherridarigaaz
